Initialize a UNO Game Session

setup_game.Rd

Sets up a playable UNO game state by generating a complete deck, shuffling it, dealing 7 cards to each player, drawing the first discard card, and initializing gameplay direction and player turn order.

Usage

setup_game(n_players)

Arguments

n_players

Integer. Number of players to initialize. Must be ≥ 2. Default is 4.
This version supports dynamic randomization of direction and starting player.
Note: Future versions may restore support for deterministic turn order and clockwise play by default, with options to override.

Value

A named list:

  • hands – Named list of player hands (each a tibble with 7 cards)

  • deck – Remaining deck (after dealing and discard)

  • discard – One-row tibble for top discard card

  • direction – Integer: 1 or -1

  • turn – Integer: randomly chosen starting player's index

Details

This function is typically the first step before calling play_turns_loop or play_game to simulate a full game.

- Shuffles the deck from create_uno_deck
- Deals 7 cards to each player
- One card is drawn as the first discard
- Direction is randomly chosen (1 = clockwise, -1 = counter-clockwise)
- Starting player is randomly selected from the available players

Examples

state <- setup_game(n_players = 4)
names(state)
#> [1] "hands"     "deck"      "discard"   "direction" "turn"     
state$hands$Player_1
#> # A tibble: 7 × 3
#>   color  value type  
#>   <chr>  <chr> <chr> 
#> 1 yellow 8     number
#> 2 yellow 6     number
#> 3 yellow 7     number
#> 4 yellow 5     number
#> 5 green  7     number
#> 6 blue   5     number
#> 7 blue   3     number
state$discard
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   color value type  
#>   <chr> <chr> <chr> 
#> 1 blue  4     number
